planets.name: HIP 113103 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of HIP 113103 with a 14.2-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: HIP 113103 c was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around HIP 113103. Its orbit and size follow Lowson et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
